caption: The drawing shows a crucifix featuring a human figure affixed to a cross. The cross is depicted in a solid black or very dark brown color. The human figure has tan or flesh-colored skin with areas of red and darker brown shading, particularly accentuating the outlines of muscles and wounds. The face of the figure shows a beard and mustache with dark hair, and the eyes are open and looking slightly downward. The head is slightly bowed to one side. The figure's arms are extended outward and upward, nailed to the horizontal beam of the cross. The torso is exposed, with lines and patches of red suggesting wounds, and the ribcage and muscles are clearly defined. The lower part of the body is covered by a cloth draped around the hips, colored in pale yellow with faint blue and red accents. The figure's legs are positioned together, with the feet crossed and nailed to the vertical beam of the cross, also showing marks of blood. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. There is a faint handwritten caption at the bottom of the image.
title: Crucifix, from Vicinity of Taos
